- `ListShortcuts` — shortcut_service.go:49
- `GetShortcut` — shortcut_service.go:95
- `CreateShortcut` — shortcut_service.go:135
- `UpdateShortcut` — shortcut_service.go:211
- `DeleteShortcut` — shortcut_service.go:284

The proto/procedure definitions live in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/shortcut_service.connect.go`, but the actual business logic backing each RPC is in `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`.
